final_rationale: The verdict changes to compliant_with_caveats not because of new evidence, but because the Actor narrowed the claim to a policy-bounded position that is more consistent with the admissible record already summarized. The available policy text blocks certification without material caveats unless the weakness is resolved or covered by an approved mitigation, and the record described does not meet that standard. But the same policy text also indicates that draft monitoring artifacts do not remove a current disclosure requirement unless approved, which supports a narrower compliant posture: certification may be supportable only if it is explicitly caveated by disclosure of the unresolved rideshare safety limitation and does not present the draft mitigation as closure. This remains a limited finding because the underlying evidence and final model-card text were not directly reviewed.
